project_name: Alauda Container Platform - Cluster Authentication Plugin
summary: Documentation for the Alauda Container Platform Cluster Authentication plugin, which provides independent authentication for global cluster failure scenarios with LDAP/OIDC support.

docs/en/index.mdx.description: Top-level English documentation landing page that renders an empty `<Overview overviewHeaders={[]} />` component, serving as the navigation entry point for the Alauda Container Platform Cluster Authentication (local-auth) plugin docs.

docs/en/install.mdx.description: Installation guide for the local-auth plugin on ACP (>= v4.2) using AC CLI (>= v1.1). Covers downloading the plugin package from AlaudaCloud, uploading via `violet push`, and two install paths: the Web Console Marketplace flow and a CLI flow that verifies `ModulePlugin`/`ModuleConfig` resources in the `global` cluster and then applies a `ModuleInfo` CR (apiVersion `cluster.alauda.io/v1alpha1`) with required `cpaas.io/cluster-name`, `cpaas.io/module-name`, and `cpaas.io/module-type=plugin` labels plus a `spec.version`. Emphasizes installing the plugin before any global cluster failure occurs.

docs/en/local-auth.mdx.description: Operator reference for configuring cluster authentication via `Connector` CRs (apiVersion `dex.coreos.com/v1`, namespace `cpaas-system`, label `cpaas.io/idp.version: v2`) whose `config` field is a base64-encoded JSON blob. Provides full LDAP examples (`bindDN`, `bindPW`, `host`, `startTLS`, `userSearch.baseDN/filter/idAttr/nameAttr/username/emailAttr`) and OIDC examples (`issuer`, `clientID`, `clientSecret`, `redirectURI` pointing at `https://<clusterEndpoint>:11780/dex/callback`, `scopes`, `claimMapping`, `getUserInfo`), with end-to-end `kubectl apply` workflows and `ac login --idp <connector> --workload --auth-type ldap|oidc` CLI usage against port 11780.

docs/en/overview/index.mdx.description: Overview section landing page that renders the auto-generated `<Overview />` component to list child pages (Introduction and Release Notes) for the Cluster Authentication plugin docs.

docs/en/overview/intro.mdx.description: Introduces the Alauda Container Platform Cluster Authentication plugin as a standalone authentication service that keeps Kubernetes cluster login working when the global cluster fails, preserving pre-failure user permissions (groups excluded). Lists key features (independent auth service, OIDC/LDAP IdP support, AC CLI >= 1.1 integration, HA design) and business-continuity / disaster-recovery use cases tied to enterprise LDAP/Active Directory and OpenID Connect providers.

docs/en/overview/release_notes.mdx.description: Release notes scaffold for plugin version 1.0.0 with placeholder sections for new features, deprecations, features-to-be-phased-out, fixed issues, and known issues. Points to the shared `release-notes-for-bugs` framework component and the external Guide to Automatically Generating Release Notes at product-doc-guide.alauda.cn for auto-population from JIRA.
